Allergen introduction

Carrot egg

Sárgarépás tojás

6 months+ Sound idea 12 min 1 portion

A proper first egg from 6 months, not a trace hidden in a bake. Try the first taste in the morning on a well day. Once egg is tolerated, keep offering it a few times a week.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 1 egg (cooked until fully set; a clear first egg)
  • 1 tbsp grated carrot (cooked soft before it goes into the egg)

Allergens

egg

Method

  1. Cook the grated carrot in a splash of water until soft.
  2. Beat the egg and stir in the carrot.
  3. Pour it into a warm pan as a thin strip, or scramble it.
  4. Cook until the egg is fully set, with no liquid yolk or white.
  5. Cool slightly and cut a soft piece.

Sound idea

A trace of egg hidden in a bake is not a clear first taste.

Beat an egg with a little grated carrot and cook it as a soft strip or scramble until fully set.
